name: FetchBox
description: Self-hosted download manager with a web interface for desktop and phone: segmented downloads with pause and resume, a queue, speed limits, file categories and statistics. One small binary, no database server.

notes.text: On first run the web interface asks for a setup code: it is printed at the end of the installation, or run `journalctl -u fetchbox | grep 'setup code'` in the container.
To keep downloads on the host (a big disk or a NAS share), set `var_downloads_dir=/path/on/the/host` when running the script, or enter it when asked.
The installer takes the program from the GitHub release of the repository (fetchbox-linux-<arch>.tar.gz), so a release with binaries must have been published.
